layout: row-major, id 1 at row 0 col 0, id 120 at row 9 col 11 (idx = id - 1; col = idx % 12; row = Math.floor(idx / 12))

colorMapping.colorSpaceConversion: sRGB hex -> linear RGB before writing to Base Color (Blender Principled BSDF expects linear)

source.logoDecal: hidden (LOGO_LEFT/LOGO_RIGHT objects set hide_render=True) - not carried on this atlas, existing teamLogoHTML crest remains the logo source of truth

renderSettings.resolution: 256x256 (rendered), cropped-to-content then padded to square then downsampled to 64x64 per cell

source.postProcess: each render's alpha bbox cropped, padded ~6% on the long edge, centered on a square canvas, LANCZOS-resized to 64x64, pasted row-major into the atlas

regeneration: To regenerate at higher resolution: reopen Dynasty_Lab_Helmet_Studio_V2.blend, isolate TEAM_001 collection, hide STUDIO_GROUND and TEAM_001_LOGO_LEFT/RIGHT, set scene.render.film_transparent=True, loop team-colors.json applying primary/secondary (sRGB->linear) to the materials listed above, render each from CAM_3Q_FRONT, then re-run the crop/pad/resize/pack step at the new target cell size.
